use_case: Tenant screening recommendations: the property management platform's integrated screening service scores each rental application and returns accept, accept with conditions (higher deposit), or decline. Adapted from the registry's 'automated tenant and buyer screening': the brokerage does no automated buyer screening
vendor_or_model: Tenant screening provider integrated in the property management platform (vendor scoring model on consumer report, eviction, criminal record, and income data)
data_categories: Applicant identity data; Social Security numbers; consumer reports (credit, eviction filings and judgments, criminal records); stated income
human_in_the_loop: Today the recommendation is used as the decision (4 changes in 276 applications). Required from 2026-10-31: the Property Manager reviews every decline and conditional approval against written criteria, with individualized review of criminal and eviction records, before any notice or owner report
applicable_laws: Fair Housing Act 42 U.S.C. 3604(a)-(b) and (f); 24 CFR 100.500 (in force; HUD proposed removal 2026); Fla. Stat. 760.23; FCRA 15 U.S.C. 1681b and 1681m(a); FCRA disposal rule 16 CFR 682.3; N53-R02 FTC Act Section 5 (45(a)); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2)
